provenance_rules.REAL: Direct statutory measurement or publication by authoritative government agency (e.g. MOIL Statutory Annual Report, ESA Copernicus).
provenance_rules.SOURCE-DERIVED: Extracted and structured from authentic government reports, mining plans, or district survey publications (e.g. Balaghat DSR 2022).
provenance_rules.SOURCE-DERIVED / PARTIAL: Authoritative tabular or descriptive source information where complete spatial cadastre or vector geometry is unreleased.
provenance_rules.DERIVED: Deterministically calculated via mathematical or projected geospatial transformations from REAL or SOURCE-DERIVED data.
provenance_rules.REFERENCE: Statutory or published reference point (centroid, village grid, prospecting trench) marking regional context.
provenance_rules.SIMULATION: Artificially generated operational telemetry, block dispatch logs, or synthetic assays used for software demonstration.
provenance_rules.EXPERIMENTAL: Machine learning rankings, unsupervised anomaly scores, and relative exploration heuristics.
provenance_rules.UNAVAILABLE: Features or cadastre where no authentic spatial vector source exists in the public domain.

datasets.notes: Tabular records of major manganese mining leases in Balaghat district with tehsil, village, khasra, area, and operational status.

datasets.dataset_name: Balaghat Leasehold Area & Statutory Grant Breakdown
datasets.notes: Detailed breakdown of forest vs non-forest lease area, grant periods, EC statutory capacities, and reconciled area discrepancy notes.

datasets.dataset_name: Balaghat Surveyed Lease Reference Points & Survey Pillars
datasets.notes: Audited statutory survey points (shaft portals, lease centroids, site references) with WGS84 and projected UTM Zone 44N metric coordinates.

datasets.dataset_name: Balaghat Validated Statutory Points & Lease Boundary Metadata
datasets.notes: Audited statutory survey and reference points for Balaghat mining leases. Boundary polygons are classified as UNAVAILABLE because complete closed boundary vector cadastre is unreleased in public domain statutory texts.

datasets.dataset_name: Balaghat Sausar Group Stratigraphy & Ore Bed Reference
datasets.notes: Stratigraphic formation descriptions, lithologies, ore mineralogy, structural strike/dip. Maintained purely as structured reference without fabricating unverified spatial polygons.

datasets.dataset_name: Balaghat Manganese Grade & Assay Distribution Reference
datasets.notes: Reported chemical grade distributions (Mn %, Fe %, SiO2 %, P %) by mine and ore category. Kept strictly as statistical distributions without fabricating synthetic drillhole collars.

datasets.dataset_name: Balaghat Exploration Drilling & UNFC Reserve Evidence
datasets.notes: Aggregate borehole counts, total meterage, exploration agencies, and UNFC reserve estimates.

datasets.dataset_name: Balaghat District & Mine Reported Historical Production
datasets.notes: District aggregate and mine-level reported production explicitly tagged with production_status.

datasets.dataset_name: Balaghat Approved Mine Plan & EC Production Targets
datasets.notes: Statutory approved planned production capacities strictly isolated from actual historical output.
Engineering and environmental constraint parameters (bench height, stripping ratio, recovery %, stowing, water discharge limits).
